theorems.statement: (∀ (P k : ℕ), volume {y : Euclid k | ∀ i, 0 < y i ∧ y i < 1} = 1 ∧ ∀ p q : (Fin k → Fin P) × (Fin P → ℤ), StrictMono p.1 → StrictMono q.1 → (∀ y y' : Euclid k, dist (WithLp.toLp 2 (fun i => (p.2 i : ℝ)) + ∑ j, y j • EuclideanSpace.single (p.1 j) (1 : ℝ)) (WithLp.toLp 2 (fun i => (p.2 i : ℝ)) + ∑ j, y' j • EuclideanSpace.single (p.1 j) (1 : ℝ)) = dist y y') ∧ (∀ y y' : Euclid k, (∀ i, 0 ≤ y i ∧ y i ≤ 1) → (∀ i, 0 ≤ y' i ∧ y' i ≤ 1) → dist (WithLp.toLp 2 (fun i => (p.2 i : ℝ)) + ∑ j, y j • EuclideanSpace.single (p.1 j) (1 : ℝ)) (WithLp.toLp 2 (fun i => (p.2 i : ℝ)) + ∑ j, y' j • EuclideanSpace.single (p.1 j) (1 : ℝ)) ≤ Real.sqrt P) ∧ (p ≠ q → ∀ y y' : Euclid k, (∀ j, 0 < y j ∧ y j < 1) → (∀ i, 0 ≤ y' i ∧ y' i ≤ 1) → 1 ≤ dist (WithLp.toLp 2 (fun i => (p.2 i : ℝ)) + ∑ j, y j • EuclideanSpace.single (p.1 j) (1 : ℝ)) (WithLp.toLp 2 (fun i => (q.2 i : ℝ)) + ∑ j, y' j • EuclideanSpace.single (q.1 j) (1 : ℝ)) ∨ ∃ j, min (y j) (1 - y j) ≤ dist (WithLp.toLp 2 (fun i => (p.2 i : ℝ)) + ∑ j, y j • EuclideanSpace.single (p.1 j) (1 : ℝ)) (WithLp.toLp 2 (fun i => (q.2 i : ℝ)) + ∑ j, y' j • EuclideanSpace.single (q.1 j) (1 : ℝ)))) → ∀ (P k : ℕ) (S : Finset ((Fin k → Fin P) × (Fin P → ℤ))), (∀ p ∈ S, StrictMono p.1) → (∀ p ∈ S, ∀ q ∈ S, p ≠ q → Disjoint ((fun y : Euclid k => WithLp.toLp 2 (fun i => (p.2 i : ℝ)) + ∑ j, y j • EuclideanSpace.single (p.1 j) (1 : ℝ)) '' {y : Euclid k | ∀ i, 0 < y i ∧ y i < 1}) ((fun y : Euclid k => WithLp.toLp 2 (fun i => (q.2 i : ℝ)) + ∑ j, y j • EuclideanSpace.single (q.1 j) (1 : ℝ)) '' {y : Euclid k | ∀ i, 0 < y i ∧ y i < 1})) ∧ ∀ p ∈ S, ∀ t : Euclid k, (∀ i, 0 < t i ∧ t i < 1) → ∃ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ ∧ ∀ z : Euclid P, dist z (WithLp.toLp 2 (fun i => (p.2 i : ℝ)) + ∑ j, t j • EuclideanSpace.single (p.1 j) (1 : ℝ)) < δ → (z ∈ ⋃ q ∈ S, (fun y : Euclid k => WithLp.toLp 2 (fun i => (q.2 i : ℝ)) + ∑ j, y j • EuclideanSpace.single (q.1 j) (1 : ℝ)) '' {y : Euclid k | ∀ i, 0 < y i ∧ y i < 1} ↔ z - (WithLp.toLp 2 (fun i => (p.2 i : ℝ)) + ∑ j, t j • EuclideanSpace.single (p.1 j) (1 : ℝ)) ∈ Submodule.span ℝ (range (fun j => EuclideanSpace.single (p.1 j) (1 : ℝ) : Fin k → Euclid P)))
